title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 22 in B-flat minor

character.text: Grand, expressive contrapuntal fugue in systematic expositions: stretto, inversion, stretto of the inversion

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times). Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times). Bass: a figure from the subject.
sections.leads: From F minor to B♭ minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in B♭ minor (Tenor); Subject in B♭ minor (Alto)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times). Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times).
sections.leads: From B♭ minor to D♭ major

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in D♭ major (Soprano); Subject in D♭ major (Bass)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence rising by a step every 2 beats. Bass: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a fourth every half bar.
sections.leads: From D♭ major to B♭ minor; perfect cadence in A♭ major at bar 40

sections.label: Subject in B♭ minor, inverted (Tenor); Subject in E♭ minor, inverted (Alto)
Episode 4
sections.summary: Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted and a figure from the subject.
sections.leads: From E♭ minor to G♭ major

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From G♭ major to A♭ minor

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times). Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times). Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From A♭ minor to B♭ minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in B♭ minor, inverted (Tenor); Subject in B♭ minor, inverted (Soprano)
Episode 7
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From B♭ minor to F minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in F minor, inverted (Alto); Subject in F minor, inverted (Bass)
Episode 8
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: From F minor to A♭ major

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in A♭ major, inverted (Soprano); Subject in A♭ major (Tenor)
Episode 9
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a fifth every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.
sections.leads: From A♭ major to B♭ minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in B♭ minor (Bass); Subject in B♭ minor, inverted (Alto)
Episode 10
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject.
sections.leads: Between two statements in B♭ minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in B♭ minor (Soprano); Subject in B♭ minor, inverted (Tenor); Subject in B♭ minor, inverted (Bass)

spans.label: Codetta
